name: Dust Marshal
lore: A bison frontier marshal: an aimed pistol round, a warned hogtie, and a close stampede.

primary.name: Six-Shooter
primary.description: Fire one fast pistol round for 22 damage. The visible round stops at the first enemy or wall.

secondary.name: Hogtie
secondary.description: After a 0.3-second rope throw, pull the aimed enemy toward a spot 48 away from you over 0.4 seconds. Deal 18 damage and stun for 2 seconds. Walls stop the pull.

special.name: High Noon Stampede
special.description: Dash forward with a dust trail, hitting each enemy once for 38 and pushing them aside.

passive: True Grit: shooting a tied enemy with Six-Shooter heals 3 HP (once per tie).

technique.name: Long Barrel

attack.name: Long Barrel
attack.description: Fire one fast pistol round for 22 damage. The visible round stops at the first enemy or wall.

technique.description: Shoot farther and harder, with slower recovery.

final_technique.name: Posse Ride

attack.name: Posse Ride
attack.description: Summon two 45-HP melee deputies for 8s, each 8 damage/sec. No stampede dash.

final_technique.description: Exchange your own mobility burst for a temporary close-fighting posse.
